model_basis: dev-profile measured gas per MAC times v0.1 MACs (attempt only, excluding 51.6 MB weight generation); labeled model, not measurement
conclusion: The v0.1 profile cannot be checked on NEAR: one attempt exceeds the 300 Tgas limit. Profile zfx-near-v1 (3.47 M MACs, ChaCha8 weights) also exceeds it when weights are regenerated inside the call, but fits when each epoch's weights are prepared once into contract storage: zfx-mine checks one attempt in ~146 Tgas and zfx-light verifies a full header in ~148 Tgas (bench/results/e2e_near_mining.json, e2e_near_light_client.json).
